"Speed" is a noun serving as the antecedent of the relative clause "your fingernails grow," not an adverbial conjunction (관계부사). The noun "speed" is modified by the relative clause, and while the relative pronoun/adverb may be omitted in the surface structure, "speed" itself is never a 관계부사. The correct analysis should identify "speed" as the antecedent (선행사) of the relative clause, not as a 관계부사.
